3.t: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand

4.t: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom
4.tr: Wa-innahoo feee Ummil Kitaabi Ladainaa la'aliyyun hakeem

5.t: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people
5.tr: Afa-nadribu 'ankumuz Zikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeen

6.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before
6.tr: Wa-kam arsalnaa min Nabiyyin fil awwaleen

7.t: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked
7.tr: Wa-maa ya'teehim min Nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

8.t: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related
8.tr: Fa-ahlaknaaa ashadda minhum batshanw Wa-madaa masalul awwaleen

9.t: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
9.tr: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda la-yaqoolunna khalaqa-hunnal 'Azeezul 'Aleem

10.t: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way
10.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw Wa-ja'ala lakum feehaa subulan la'allakum tahtadoon

11.t: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺
11.tr: Wallazee nazzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an biqadarin fa-ansharnaa bihee baldatan maitaa' kazaalika tukhrajoon

12.t: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride
12.tr: Wallazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa Wa-ja'ala lakum minal fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon

13.t: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺
13.tr: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izas tawaitum 'alaihi Wa-taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza Wa-maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen

14.t: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”

15.t: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful
15.tr: Wa-ja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa; innal insaana la-kafoorun mubeen

16.t: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons
16.tr: Amit takhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaatinw Wa-asfaakum bilbaneen

17.t: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage
17.tr: Wa-izaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-Rahmaani masalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw Wa-huwa kazeem

18.t: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes
18.tr: Awa-maien yunashsha'u fil hilyati Wa-huwa fil khisaami ghairu mubeen

19.t: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned
19.tr: Wa-ja'alul malaaa'ikatal lazeena hum 'ibaadur Rahmaani inaasaa; 'a-shahidoo khalqahum; satuktabu shahaadatuhum Wa-yus'aloon

20.t: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie
20.tr: Wa-qaaloo law shaaa'ar Rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum; maa lahum bizaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon

21.t: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm
21.tr: Am aatainaahum Kitaaban min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon

22.t: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”
22.tr: Bal qaalooo innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw Wa-innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muhtadoon

23.t: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”
23.tr: Wa-kazaalika maaa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaaa innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw Wa-innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muqtadoon

24.t: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”
24.tr: Qaala awa-law ji'tukum bi-ahdaa mimmaa wajatdtum 'alaihi aabaaa'akum qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon

25.t: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers
25.tr: Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen

26.t: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship
26.tr: Wa-iz qaala Ibraaheemu li-abeehi Wa-qawmiheee innanee baraaa'un mimmaa ta'budoon

27.t: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”

28.t: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺
28.tr: Wa-ja'alahaa kalimatan baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la-'allahum yarji'oon

29.t: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear
29.tr: Bal matta'tu haaa'ulaaa'i Wa-aabaaa'ahum hattaa jaaa'a-humul haqqu Wa-Rasoolun mubeen

30.t: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”
30.tr: Wa-lammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu qaaloo haazaa sihrunw Wa-innaa bihee kaafiroon

31.t: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”
31.tr: Wa-qaaloo law-laa nuzzila haazal Quraanu 'alaa rajulin minal qaryataini 'azeem

32.t: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass
32.tr: A-hum yaqsimoona rahmata Rabbik; Nahnu qasamnaa bainahum ma'eeshatahum fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatin li-yattakhiza ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa; Wa-rahmatu Rabbika khairun mimmaa yajma'oon

33.t: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend
33.tr: Wa-law-laaa aien yakoonan naasu ummatanw waahidatan laja'alnaa limaien yakfuru bir-Rahmaani li-buyootihim suqufan min fiddatinw Wa-ma'aarija 'alaihaa yazharoon

34.t: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on

35.t: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺
35.tr: Wa-zukhrufaa; Wa-in kullu zaalika lammaa mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wal-aakhiratu 'inda Rabbika lilmuttaqeen

36.t: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate
36.tr: Wa-maien ya'shu 'an zikrir Rahmaani nuqaiyid lahoo Shaitaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen

37.t: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided
37.tr: Wa-innahum la-yasuddoo-nahum 'anis sabeeli Wa-yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon

38.t: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”
38.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'anaa qaala yaa-laita bainee Wa-bainaka bu'dal mashriqaini fabi'sal qareen

39.t: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”
39.tr: Wa-lai yanfa'akumul Yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil 'azaabi mushtarikoon

40.t: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray
40.tr: Afa-anta tusmi'us summa aw tahdil 'umya Wa-man kaana fee dalaalin mubeen

41.t: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them
41.tr: Fa-immaa nazhabanna bika fa-innaa minhum muntaqimoon

42.t: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them
42.tr: Aw nuriyannakal lazee wa'adnaahum fa-innaa 'alaihim muqtadiroon

43.t: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path
43.tr: Fastamsik billazeee oohiya ilaika innaka 'alaa Siraatin Mustaqeem

44.t: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺
44.tr: Wa-innahoo la-zikrun laka Wa-liqawmika Wa-sawfa tus'aloon

45.t: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate
45.tr: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir Rusulinaaa 'a-ja'alnaa min doonir Rahmaani aalihatany yu'badoon

46.t: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”
46.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi-aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awna Wa-mala'ihee faqaala innee Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

47.t: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them
47.tr: Falamma jaaa'ahum bi-aayaatinaaa izaa hum minhaa yadhakoon

48.t: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺
48.tr: Wa-maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa Wa-akhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'allahum yarji'oon

49.t: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”
49.tr: Wa-qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa Rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon

50.t: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise

51.t: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see
51.tr: Wa-naadaa Fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa-qawmi alaisa lee mulku Misra Wa-haazihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon

52.t: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself
52.tr: Am ana khairun min haazal lazee huwa maheenunw Wa-laa yakaadu yubeen

53.t: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”
53.tr: Falaw-laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratun min zahabin aw jaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen

54.t: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people
54.tr: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa-ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen

55.t: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all
55.tr: Falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa-aghraqnaahum ajma'een

56.t: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them

57.t: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause
57.tr: Wa-lammaa duribab nu Maryama masalan izaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon

58.t: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute
58.tr: Wa-qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; bal hum qawmun khasimoon

59.t: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel
59.tr: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi Wa-ja'alnaahu masalan li-Baneee Israaa'eel

60.t: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth
60.tr: Wa-law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon

61.t: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path
61.tr: Wa-innahoo la-'ilmun lis-Saa'ati fa-laa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haazaa Siraatun Mustaqeem

62.t: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy
62.tr: Wa-laa yasuddan-nakumush Shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwun mubeen

63.t: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me
63.tr: Wa-lammaa jaaa'a 'Eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil-Hikmati Wa-li-ubaiyyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha Wa-atee'oon

64.t: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
64.tr: Innal laaha Huwa Rabbee Wa-Rabbukum fa'budooh; haaza Siraatum Mustaqeem

65.t: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day
65.tr: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu min bainihim fa-wailun lil-lazeena zalamoo min 'azaabi Yawmin aleem

66.t: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺
66.tr: Hal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatanw Wa-hum laa yash'uroon

67.t: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous
67.tr: Al-akhillaaa'u Yawma'izin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen

68.t: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—
68.tr: Yaa-'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul Yawma Wa-laaa antum tahzanoon

69.t: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺

70.t: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”

71.t: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever
71.tr: Yutaafu 'alaihim bi-sihafin min zahabinw Wa-akwaab, Wa-feehaa maa tashtaheehil anfusu Wa-talazzul a'yunu Wa-antum feehaa khaalidoon

72.t: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do
72.tr: Wa-tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

73.t: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from
73.tr: Lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratun minhaa ta'kuloon

74.t: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever

75.t: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair

76.t: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers
76.tr: Wa-maa zalamnaahum Wa-laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen

77.t: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”
77.tr: Wa-naadaw yaa-Maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa Rabbuka qaala innakum maakithoon

78.t: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth
78.tr: Laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi Wa-laakinna aksarakum lil-haqqi kaarihoon

79.t: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning

80.t: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺
80.tr: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum Wa-najwaahum; balaa Wa-Rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon

81.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”
81.tr: Qul in kaana lir-Rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen

82.t: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
82.tr: Subhaana Rabbis samaawaati wal-ardi Rabbil Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

83.t: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of
83.tr: Fazarhum yakhoodoo Wa-yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo Yawmahumul lazee yoo'adoon

84.t: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing
84.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee fis samaaa'i ilaahunw Wa-fil ardi ilaah; Wa-Huwal Hakeemul 'Aleem

85.t: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned
85.tr: Wa-tabaarakal lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa Wa-'indahoo 'ilmus Saa'ati Wa-ilaihi turja'oon

86.t: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly
86.tr: Wa-laa yamlikul lazeena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi Wa-hum ya'lamoon

87.t: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
87.tr: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqahum la-yaqoolun nallaahu fa-annaa yu'fakoon

88.t: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”
88.tr: Wa-qeelihee yaa-Rabbi inna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon

89.t: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know
